answer: Think of each identity as a vertex in a credit graph: the network requires one distinct credit file, held by an independent bureau, with years of real borrowing and repayment behind it. A farm can spin up wallets by the dune-load, but it cannot fabricate a decade of on-time payments — the nebula of small, boring, verifiable financial acts that only a real economic life produces. One file, one voice; a fresh file with no history earns no weight until it ages into one.
